subject: Open Meeting Law Training
overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities received an Open Meeting Law presentation from legal counsel and planned for an upcoming disability resource fair.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the April meeting minutes as amended.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Presentation
items.summary: Janelle Austin delivered a presentation on Massachusetts Open Meeting Law requirements, detailing rules on public notice, email deliberations, subcommittees, and remote meeting options before answering commissioners' questions.

items.title: Disability Product Resource Fair Planning
items.summary: Commissioners assigned outreach responsibilities for vendors and organizations for the October 7, 2023 fair at the Brooks School and discussed a proposed photography initiative.

items.title: Staff Updates and Announcements
items.summary: Staff announced Commissioner Marcia Kirssen's upcoming retirement from the commission, and members shared announcements regarding upcoming city flag raisings, community walks, and federal accessibility comment periods.
